# Version 4.156.0
> **GTK4 GPU rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews a native GTK4 GPU canvas alongside the Skia m156 engine update.

## Breaking Changes

- **Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to use logical paint coordinates while retaining full-resolution backing pixels; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Target Tizen 10 or later** — New SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages target net10.0-tizen10.0 on x64 and arm64 only; Tizen 8/9 and 32-bit targets are unsupported. Retarget consuming applications to Tizen 10 and a supported architecture; source builds require the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain. Tizen 10 device/package loading was not validated in the collected evidence. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the bundled renderer to m156. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.100 without upgrading the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext, optional tick-driven rendering, and GTK QueueRender invalidation. It uses GTK-provided GL contexts through libepoxy; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include that dispatcher. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery** — Restores directory-backed default font discovery without adding fontconfig. Fonts are scanned from /usr/share/fonts/ unless the native build overrides the directory; an empty scan retains the existing empty-family fallback. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **GTK4 raster pixel ownership** — Releases the Skia surface before its Cairo-owned pixel storage and marks pixels dirty after channel swizzling, keeping raster buffer lifetime and updates in ownership order. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly toolchain alignment** — Selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 and later targets in both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. .NET 8 stays on 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 stay on 3.1.56. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly archives with Emscripten 6.0.2 and raises Tizen native packages to Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64. Package revision 14.4.0.100 still uses native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Introduced Skia m156 and the GTK4 GPU canvas, with physical-pixel raster painting by default. Restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, aligned .NET 11 WASM archives, and required Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64.
